inlines.v: DISENGAGED, participle passive 1. Separated; detached; set free; released; disjoined; disentangled. 2.a. Vacant; being at leisure; not particularly occupied; not having the attention confined to a particular object. [This word is thus used by mistake for unengaged, not engaged.]
